gaps.message: benchmarks/tgv/3e-3g: no registered selector; revisions are discoverable, not assumed current
Installed qgraf-pipeline and Montopar share a dirty parent repository; HEAD alone does not identify emitted C/J. Frozen snapshots remain authoritative.
Some family manifests do not express per-orbit graph-to-C/J lineage; family-level provenance is marked needs_review.
Existing historical references to mutable selectors or code may no longer match current bytes. These versions remain unresolved; old evidence is not rebound.
The 2026-10-06 RG selector's missing-integral count is historical. Current double-TGV selector has 3 incomplete IDs (15,16,24).
Index coverage is bounded to registered sources; absence of a downstream edge is not a mathematical independence proof.

The external matter non-cusp coefficient comparison has an unresolved geometric log-scale dictionary (log 2); arithmetic equality does not yet establish the physical convention bridge. See the 2026-10-17 second-stage review and its subsequent erratum; nf2/cff raw-source finite shapes are separate.
